findings.title: Mutable default argument in accumulate
findings.rule_text: Never use a mutable default argument; default to None and build inside the body.
findings.issue: accumulate uses acc=[] as a default, which is shared across calls.
findings.suggested_fix: Default acc to None and create a fresh list in the body.

findings.title: Deeply nested clamp logic
findings.rule_text: Prefer flat expressions over nested if/else where a builtin expresses the intent.
findings.issue: clamp nests if/else three deep where min/max would read clearer.
findings.suggested_fix: Collapse to a single bounded expression with min and max, preserving the same results.

findings.title: Dead zero-special-case in label
findings.rule_text: Remove dead branches that duplicate the default path.
findings.issue: The n == 0 branch looks redundant since str(n) would also handle it.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete the n == 0 branch and fall through to str(n).

findings.title: No shared input validator across modules
findings.rule_text: Validate inputs through one shared validator used by every public function.
findings.issue: Every public function validates ad hoc; there is no shared validator introduced across all modules.
findings.suggested_fix: Introduce a shared validator and route every public function across the codebase through it.
